cases.question: Tell me about a time you fixed a production incident.
cases.answer: Situation: our checkout API started timing out on Black Friday morning. Task: I was the on-call owner and had to restore it fast. Action: I traced the timeouts to a missing index on the orders table, added the index online, and drained the retry queue. Result: p99 latency dropped from 40 seconds to 300 milliseconds and checkout recovered within twenty minutes.
